	_info("physics ticks per second = %d, max_fps = %d" % [Engine.physics_ticks_per_second, Engine.max_fps])

	# ---- 1. Structure: nodes, clips, autoplay, for the player and every enemy ----
	var main = await _new_game()
	var p = main.player
	var tanks: Array = [p]
	tanks.append_array(main.enemies)
	var structure_ok := true
	var detail := ""
	for t in tanks:
		var motion_anim = t.get_node_or_null("MotionAnim")
		var fire_anim = t.get_node_or_null("FireAnim")
		if motion_anim == null or fire_anim == null or t.get_node_or_null("Suspension") == null \
				or t.get_node_or_null("DustMount/Dust") == null:
			structure_ok = false
			detail += " %s: missing node;" % t.name
			continue
		if not motion_anim.has_animation("track_dust") or not fire_anim.has_animation("shoot"):
			structure_ok = false
			detail += " %s: clip missing;" % t.name
		if motion_anim.autoplay != "" or fire_anim.autoplay != "":
			structure_ok = false
			detail += " %s: autoplay set;" % t.name
		if motion_anim.is_playing() or fire_anim.is_playing():
			structure_ok = false
			detail += " %s: playing at start;" % t.name
		if t.get_node("DustMount").visible or t._motion != IDLE or t._weapon != READY:
			structure_ok = false
			detail += " %s: not idle/ready at start;" % t.name
	_check("S1 player and %d enemies have Suspension, DustMount/Dust, both players with their clip, autoplay empty, idle at start" % main.enemies.size(),
		structure_ok, detail)
	_check("S1b hull and turret are children of Suspension", p.hull.get_parent() == p.get_node("Suspension") and p.turret.get_parent() == p.get_node("Suspension"))
	await _free_game(main)

	# ---- 2. Motion machine ----
	main = await _new_game()
	var snaps: Array = await _scenario(main, {"move": true})
	var first_move: int = -999
	var first_idle_after: int = -999
	var dir_on: int = -999
	var dir_off: int = -999
	for s in snaps:
		if first_move == -999 and s["motion"] == MOVING:
			first_move = s["k"]
		if first_move != -999 and first_idle_after == -999 and s["motion"] == IDLE:
			first_idle_after = s["k"]
		if dir_on == -999 and s["move_dir"] != Vector2.ZERO:
			dir_on = s["k"]
		if dir_on != -999 and dir_off == -999 and s["move_dir"] == Vector2.ZERO:
			dir_off = s["k"]
	_check("M1 IDLE at rest before the press (every tick before move_dir turns non-zero)", _all(snaps, -99, -1, "motion", IDLE) and _all(snaps, -99, -1, "dust_visible", false) and _all(snaps, -99, -1, "move_playing", false))
	_check("M2 MOVING on the same tick move_dir turns non-zero", first_move == dir_on and dir_on > 0, "motion=%d move_dir=%d" % [first_move, dir_on])
	var moving_ok := true
	for s in snaps:
		if s["k"] >= first_move and s["k"] < first_idle_after:
			if not (s["move_playing"] and s["move_clip"] == "track_dust" and s["dust_visible"] and s["motion"] == MOVING):
				moving_ok = false
	_check("M3 while MOVING: track_dust playing every tick and dust visible", moving_ok)
	_check("M4 back to IDLE on the same tick move_dir returns to zero (release injected at resume %d)" % HOLD, first_idle_after == dir_off and dir_off > HOLD, "motion=%d move_dir=%d" % [first_idle_after, dir_off])
	var idle_ok := true
	for s in snaps:
		if s["k"] >= first_idle_after and (s["move_playing"] or s["dust_visible"] or s["motion"] != IDLE):
			idle_ok = false
	_check("M5 after release: MotionAnim stopped, dust hidden", idle_ok)
	_check("M6 FireAnim never ran during a pure move", _all(snaps, -99, 99, "fire_playing", false) and _all(snaps, -99, 99, "weapon", READY))
	await _free_game(main)

	# ---- 3. Weapon machine at rest, fire held ----
	main = await _new_game()
	snaps = await _scenario(main, {"fire": true})
	var shell_rises := _rises(snaps, "shells")
	var sound_rises := _rises(snaps, "sounds")
	var muzzle_rises := _rises(snaps, "muzzles")
	_check("W1 press tick (first FIRING): reload starts on it (0.8 s) and not before; shoot starts on it",
		_first(snaps, "reload", 0.8) == 0 and _all(snaps, -99, -1, "reload", 0.0) and _first(snaps, "fire_clip", "shoot") == 0,
		"reload first=%d shoot first=%d" % [_first(snaps, "reload", 0.8), _first(snaps, "fire_clip", "shoot")])
	_check("W2 no shell, muzzle FX or fire sound on ticks 0 and 1", _all(snaps, 0, SHELL_REL - 1, "shells", 0) and _all(snaps, 0, SHELL_REL - 1, "muzzles", 0) and _all(snaps, 0, SHELL_REL - 1, "sounds", 0))
	_check("W3 shell appears on tick 2 and only once", shell_rises.slice(0, 2) == [SHELL_REL] and _all(snaps, SHELL_REL, READY_REL + 5, "shells", 1), str(shell_rises))
	_check("W4 fire sound appears on tick 2, once", sound_rises == [SHELL_REL], str(sound_rises))
	_check("W5 muzzle FX appears on tick 2", muzzle_rises.size() > 0 and muzzle_rises[0] == SHELL_REL, str(muzzle_rises))
	_check("W6 weapon FIRING through tick 9", _all(snaps, 0, READY_REL - 1, "weapon", FIRING))
	_check("W7 weapon back to READY on tick 10", _first(snaps, "weapon", READY, 3) == READY_REL, "first=%d" % _first(snaps, "weapon", READY, 3))
	_check("W8 FireAnim plays shoot on ticks 0-8", _all(snaps, 0, 8, "fire_clip", "shoot") and _all(snaps, 0, 8, "fire_playing", true))
	_check("W9 FireAnim finished by tick 11", _all(snaps, 11, 99, "fire_playing", false))
	_check("W10 MotionAnim idle and dust hidden the whole time (no movement)", _all(snaps, -99, 99, "move_playing", false) and _all(snaps, -99, 99, "dust_visible", false))
	_check("W11 no second shell while held through the 48-tick reload (only the held-fire ticks seen)", shell_rises.size() == 1, str(shell_rises))
	await _free_game(main)

	# ---- 4. FIRING guard: reload forced to 0 every tick, fire held ----
	main = await _new_game()
	snaps = await _scenario(main, {"fire": true, "force_reload0": true})
	shell_rises = _rises(snaps, "shells")
	var pos_monotonic := true
	var prev_pos := -1.0
	for s in snaps:
		if s["rel"] >= 0 and s["rel"] <= 8:
			if s["fire_pos"] < prev_pos:
				pos_monotonic = false
			prev_pos = s["fire_pos"]
	_check("G1 reload at 0 every tick: shells on ticks [2, 12] only (a press during FIRING is ignored, the second shot starts on READY)", shell_rises.slice(0, 2) == [SHELL_REL, READY_REL + SHELL_REL] and shell_rises.size() == 2, str(shell_rises))
	_check("G2 shoot never restarted during FIRING (position non-decreasing on ticks 0-8)", pos_monotonic)
	_check("G3 weapon FIRING on every tick 0-19 (back-to-back shots)", _all(snaps, 0, 19, "weapon", FIRING))
	await _free_game(main)

	# ---- 5. Fire while moving ----
	main = await _new_game()
	snaps = await _scenario(main, {"fire": true, "move": true})
	var mf_ok := true
	for s in snaps:
		if s["rel"] >= 0 and s["k"] <= HOLD:
			if not (s["move_playing"] and s["move_clip"] == "track_dust" and s["dust_visible"]):
				mf_ok = false
	_check("F1 firing while driving: track_dust keeps playing and the dust stays visible", mf_ok)
	_check("F2 shell still on tick 2 while moving", _rises(snaps, "shells").slice(0, 1) == [SHELL_REL], str(_rises(snaps, "shells")))
	await _free_game(main)

	# ---- 6. Interrupts: hit and death in startup, active, recovery ----
	for case in [["startup", 1], ["active", 2], ["recovery", 5]]:
		var label: String = case[0]
		var r: int = case[1]
		main = await _new_game()
		var pl = main.player
		snaps = await _scenario(main, {"fire": true, "actions": {r: func(): pl.take_damage(10)}})
		_check("H-%s hit on tick %d: shot continues (shell tick 2, FIRING to tick 9, READY tick 10)" % [label, r],
			snaps[-1]["health"] < snaps[0]["health"] and not snaps[-1]["dead"] \
				and _rises(snaps, "shells").slice(0, 1) == [SHELL_REL] and _all(snaps, 0, READY_REL - 1, "weapon", FIRING) and _first(snaps, "weapon", READY, 3) == READY_REL,
			"health %d->%d shells=%s ready=%d" % [snaps[0]["health"], snaps[-1]["health"], str(_rises(snaps, "shells")), _first(snaps, "weapon", READY, 3)])
		await _free_game(main)

		main = await _new_game()
		pl = main.player
		snaps = await _scenario(main, {"fire": true, "actions": {r: func(): pl.take_damage(100000)}})
		var dead_seen: bool = snaps[-1]["dead"]
		_check("D-%s death on tick %d: shell still on tick 2 (once), sound once, FIRING to tick 9, READY tick 10" % [label, r],
			dead_seen and _rises(snaps, "shells") == [SHELL_REL] and _rises(snaps, "sounds") == [SHELL_REL] and _all(snaps, 0, READY_REL - 1, "weapon", FIRING) and _first(snaps, "weapon", READY, 3) == READY_REL,
			"dead=%s shells=%s sounds=%s ready=%d" % [str(dead_seen), str(_rises(snaps, "shells")), str(_rises(snaps, "sounds")), _first(snaps, "weapon", READY, 3)])
		await _free_game(main)

	# ---- 7. Death while moving: leaves MOVING, dust hidden ----
	main = await _new_game()
	var pl2 = main.player
	var r_kill := 8              # killed just before rel tick 8 of the drive
	snaps = await _scenario(main, {"move": true, "actions": {r_kill: func(): pl2.take_damage(100000)}})
	var s_before: Dictionary = snaps.filter(func(s): return s["rel"] == r_kill - 1)[0]
	var s_after: Dictionary = snaps.filter(func(s): return s["rel"] == r_kill)[0]
	_check("X1 before the kill: MOVING, dust visible, track_dust playing", s_before["motion"] == MOVING and s_before["dust_visible"] and s_before["move_playing"])
	var after_ok := true
	for s in snaps:
		if s["rel"] >= r_kill and (s["motion"] != IDLE or s["dust_visible"] or s["move_playing"]):
			after_ok = false
	_check("X2 on the tick of death: IDLE, dust hidden, MotionAnim stopped, stays so (move_right still held)", s_after["dead"] and after_ok)
	await _free_game(main)

	# ---- 8. Two clocks: FireAnim position against the tick the shell spawns on ----
	_info("two-clocks: FireAnim.current_animation_position after each tick, press tick = rel 0; frame 1 = %.4f s" % (1.0 / 30.0))
	var diffs := []
	for run in CLOCK_RUNS:
		main = await _new_game()
		snaps = await _scenario(main, {"fire": true})
		var anim_rel := -999
		var line := ""
		for s in snaps:
			if s["rel"] >= 0 and s["rel"] <= 6:
				line += " rel%d=%.4f" % [s["rel"], s["fire_pos"]]
			if anim_rel == -999 and s["rel"] >= 0 and s["fire_pos"] >= 1.0 / 30.0 - 0.0001:
				anim_rel = s["rel"]
		var shell_rel2: int = _rises(snaps, "shells")[0] if _rises(snaps, "shells").size() > 0 else -999
		var diff: int = shell_rel2 - anim_rel
		diffs.append(diff)
		_info("run %d:%s | animation reaches frame 1 at rel %d, shell at rel %d, shell - anim = %d tick(s)" % [run, line, anim_rel, shell_rel2, diff])
		await _free_game(main)
	var worst := 0
	for d in diffs:
		worst = maxi(worst, absi(d))
	_info("CLOCKS physics_ticks_per_second=%d: largest |shell tick - animation frame-1 tick| over %d runs = %d tick(s) = %.4f s; per run %s" % [
		Engine.physics_ticks_per_second, CLOCK_RUNS, worst, worst / float(Engine.physics_ticks_per_second), str(diffs)])
	_check("C1 two-clocks disagreement <= 1 physics tick (brief prediction)", worst <= 1, "worst=%d" % worst)
	_check("C2 the same number in every run", diffs.count(diffs[0]) == diffs.size(), str(diffs))

	print("RESULT: %d passed, %d failed" % [passed, failed])
	quit(1 if failed > 0 else 0)

content.text:
All six commands ran. With the revised test, `test_anim_states` passes 34/0 at 30, 60 and 144. `test_clip_readback` (49/0) and `test_sound_triggers` (0 failed) pass. `test_pins` fails exactly the pins you predicted, plus PIN-1, which is the same +2 shift. Nothing is committed.

**About the starting point:** `scripts/tank.gd`, the edit to `test_sound_triggers.gd` and a draft of `tests/test_anim_states.gd` were already in the tree. They were written at 18:24–18:26, before this prompt (18:31), apparently by an earlier run of the same task. I checked them against the plan and your four decisions, kept `tank.gd` and the sound-trigger edit as they were, and fixed two problems in the test:
- **Error spam:** it printed ~70 `ERROR: AnimationPlayer has no current animation` lines because it read the clip position while nothing was playing. It now checks `is_playing()` first.
- **Wrong input-latency assumption:** it assumed input reaches the game 1 tick after injection. My first 30 fps run failed 20 of 34 because of this. At `--fixed-fps 30` there are two physics ticks per frame and the input arrives 2 ticks later; the game itself was right relative to its press tick (shell +2, READY +10). Each scenario now takes its press tick P from what the game actually did (first FIRING, or first non-zero `move_dir`), and hits and deaths are scheduled relative to P. The hit cases also check that health actually dropped.

## `tank.gd` (plan steps 1–4, your decisions 1 and 3)
- **States:** `Motion {IDLE, MOVING}` and `Weapon {READY, FIRING}`. The tick numbers come from `SHOOT_FPS`, `SHOOT_ACTIVE_FRAME` and `SHOOT_END_FRAME`, so there is no literal 2 or 10.
- **`_weapon_tick()`** runs before the `is_dead` return. On the active tick it spawns the shell, muzzle FX and fire sound, reading `muzzle_position()` and `aim_vec()` on that tick. It sets READY at frame 5.
- **`try_fire()`** has the FIRING guard. Reload, recoil and `fired.emit` stay on the press tick.
- **`_update_motion()`** starts and stops `MotionAnim` and sets `DustMount` position and visibility. A dead tank goes to IDLE.
- **Authority (step 5):** a grep of `scripts/` finds writes to `_weapon` and `_motion`, and calls to `play()`/`stop()` on the two players, only in `tank.gd`. Nothing outside `tank.gd` touches `Suspension`.

## `tests/test_sound_triggers.gd`: every changed line
Four lines added, none changed or removed:
- **Lines 34–35:** `while p._weapon == p.Weapon.FIRING: await physics_frame`, after the ten `try_fire()` calls. The sound now comes on the active tick, so the count has to wait for it. Waiting until FIRING ends also covers your rule to wait for FIRING to end before the second `try_fire()`.
- **Lines 39–40:** the same wait after the second `try_fire()`, so its sound has played before the second count.

## Two-clocks measurement (step 7)
The physics rate is 60 Hz in all three modes. Over 5 runs each, the result was identical every time:

| `--fixed-fps` | `FireAnim` position at P+0 … P+3 | Clip reaches frame 1 | Shell | Shell − clip |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30 | 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0167, 0.0333 | P+3 | P+2 | −1 tick |
| 60 | same | P+3 | P+2 | −1 tick |
| 144 | same | P+3 | P+2 | −1 tick |

So the largest disagreement is **1 physics tick (0.0167 s)**, within the brief's prediction. The shell leaves one tick before the clip reaches its frame-1 dip. The clip position stays at 0 on both P and P+1, so the player starts advancing a tick late; I have not confirmed in the engine source why. The number is yours to put in the brief's placeholder; I did not edit the brief.

## `test_pins.gd` (file unchanged)
- **PIN-2:** measured 2, expected 0 (+2, as predicted).
- **PIN-4:** measured 2, expected 0 (+2, as predicted).
- **PIN-1 also fails, and you didn't list it.** It pins the whole sequence: shells measured at 2, 50 and 98 against 0, 48 and 96. Each shell is +2 and the move events (−40, −10) are unchanged, so it is the brief's predicted change, but it is a third failing pin.
- PIN-3 (48-tick reload interval) and every other pin pass.

## One rule I bent: please decide
G1 writes `p.reload_left = 0.0` every tick. Without that the FIRING guard cannot be seen, because the 48-tick reload already blocks a second shot inside the 10-tick FIRING window. Firing in G1 still goes through `parse_input_event`, but this is a direct state write that decision 4 did not allow. If you don't want it, deleting G1–G3 leaves the guard untested.

## Run output
Most is copied from the terminal. For the repeated `test_anim_states` runs I show the lines that differ and the result, and the full logs are in `logs/`.

**`bash scripts/run-test.sh test_anim_states.gd 30`**, first run, before the test fix (exit 1):
```
FAIL  M2 MOVING first seen at resume 2 (move_right injected at 0, latency 1)  | first=3
FAIL  W3 shell appears on tick 2 and only once  | [3]
FAIL  W7 weapon back to READY on tick 10  | first=11
FAIL  D-startup death on tick 1: ...  | dead=true shells=[] sounds=[] ready=1
...
RESULT: 14 passed, 20 failed
```

**`bash scripts/run-test.sh test_anim_states.gd 30`**, after the fix: every check passes, with `press tick P seen 2 tick(s) after the injection` and `RESULT: 34 passed, 0 failed`.

**60 and 144 fps**, after the fix: identical to each other, with `press tick P seen 1 tick(s) after the injection` and `RESULT: 34 passed, 0 failed`. Key lines:
```
PASS  W1 press tick (first FIRING): reload starts on it (0.8 s) and not before; shoot starts on it  | reload first=0 shoot first=0
PASS  W3 shell appears on tick 2 and only once  | [2]
PASS  W7 weapon back to READY on tick 10  | first=10
PASS  G1 reload at 0 every tick: shells on ticks [2, 12] only ...  | [2, 12]
PASS  D-startup death on tick 1: shell still on tick 2 (once), sound once, ...  | dead=true shells=[2] sounds=[2] ready=10
INFO  CLOCKS physics_ticks_per_second=60: largest |shell tick - animation frame-1 tick| over 5 runs = 1 tick(s) = 0.0167 s; per run [-1, -1, -1, -1, -1]
PASS  C1 two-clocks disagreement <= 1 physics tick (brief prediction)  | worst=1
RESULT: 34 passed, 0 failed
```

**`bash scripts/run-test.sh test_clip_readback.gd 60`:** all 49 checks pass, `readback: 49 passed, 0 failed`.

**`bash scripts/run-test.sh test_sound_triggers.gd 60`:**
```
PASS  10 fire presses in one frame -> 1 shell, 1 fire sound
PASS  fire again after reload -> 2nd fire sound
... (6 more PASS)
RESULT: 0 failed
```

**`bash scripts/run-test.sh test_pins.gd 60`** (exit 1):
```
FAIL  PIN-1 sequence of move_dir changes and shells | measured=[[-40, "move_start"], [-10, "move_stop"], [2, "shell"], [50, "shell"], [98, "shell"]] expected=[[-40, "move_start"], [-10, "move_stop"], [0, "shell"], [48, "shell"], [96, "shell"]]
FAIL  PIN-2 first shell tick vs press [PREDICTED TO CHANGE by A7 brief: +2 ticks] | measured=2 expected=0
PASS  PIN-3 reload interval, ticks between shell 1 and 2 while fire held | measured=48 expected=48
FAIL  PIN-4 fire sound tick vs press [PREDICTED TO CHANGE by A7 brief: +2 ticks]; ... | measured=2 expected=0
RESULT: 8 passed, 3 failed
```

## Not run
- I ran only your six commands, so the other baseline suites from CLAUDE.md (`test_hit_flash`, the A6 state tests and so on) have not been re-run against this change.

## Human checks
- **Dust:** `DUST_BEHIND = 14` is a guess. Its registration in all 8 facings, the seam over at least 5 wraps, and visibility over dark and light ground need your eyes.
- **Shot:** whether the dip reads and the shot feels crisp, which needs the frame strip and play at normal speed and at `--time-scale 0.25`.

The test runner also rewrote `logs/test_pins_60fps.log` and `logs/test_sound_triggers_60fps.log`.
